test_title: PYST 31 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 24 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Identify the meaning of the phrase highlighted in bold.

In radiant secrecy, Sheela **burned the midnight oil** and prepared woolen sweaters for the beggars around the street.

options.text: Work hard for a long time

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Work hard for a long time**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"burn the midnight oil"** means to work late into the night or work hard for a long time. (रातभर मेहनत करना)
 
 
• **Example:** She burned the midnight oil to complete her project before the deadline.
 
 
• The word **"work hard for a long time"** aligns with the meaning of "burn the midnight oil" as it refers to putting in extended effort, especially at night. (लंबे समय तक कड़ी मेहनत करना)
 
 
• **Example:** Students often burn the midnight oil during exam preparation.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Work hard for a long time**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2: Work for a few minutes** (कुछ मिनटों तक काम करना): Refers to working for a very short duration. 
 
 
• **Example:** He worked for a few minutes and then took a break.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: Go early to bed** (जल्दी सोने जाना): Refers to sleeping early at night. 
 
 
• **Example:** She prefers to go early to bed to wake up fresh in the morning.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: Wake up very early** (बहुत जल्दी उठना): Refers to rising early in the morning. 
 
 
• **Example:** Farmers often wake up very early to start their work.
 
 

36:Te05,
The correct answer is **Option 2**.
